metadata.title: AMD shares dip, Super Micro's pop after earnings, and other early movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
4 months ago
AMD shares dip, Super Micro's pop after earnings, and other early movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Wednesday's premarket action:
Advanced Micro Devices stock is falling nearly 7% after the chipmaker's solid earnings report could not support a share price that had risen 116% over the last 12 months.
Silicon Laboratories shares are surging more than 30% after The Financial Times reported that Texas Instruments is in advanced talks to buy the chip designer.
Super Micro Computer shares are jumping nearly 12% after results from the server-maker showed last-quarter revenues rising 123% to record levels.
Enphase Energy stock is popping 21% after the energy technology company posted profit and revenue that topped Wall Street's estimates.
Lumentum Holdings shares are up nearly 8% after the fiber optic company's results beat expectations.
Chipotle Mexican Grill shares are down 6% after the fast-casual restaurant chain’s same-store sales outlook came in below analysts' forecasts.
Take-Two Interactive Software shares are up 4% after the videogame company narrowed its loss and posted a jump in sales during its fiscal third quarter.
